ai_complex.disclaimer_llm: T2Editor AI answers based on generative AI (LLM). Responses may contain inaccurate or incorrect content, so please double-check anything important before applying.
ai_complex.disclaimer_privacy: To produce an answer, your input may be sent to an external AI API provider. By continuing to use T2Editor AI, you agree to this processing.
ai_complex.intro_about_lede: T2Editor complex AI runs on top of the T2Editor AI base system.
ai_complex.intro_dev_lede: Looking a bit deeper, the T2Editor AI base system works like this.
ai_complex.intro_dev_bridge_lede: That's the T2Editor AI base system; the T2Editor complex AI plugin you're using now adds these two things on top.
ai_complex.intro_about_tools_desc: Helps with tasks that conversation alone can't handle — document search, image insertion, external lookups. You always choose which tools to enable.
ai_complex.intro_about_skills_desc: Saves frequently used workflows or writing styles. Once saved, the same style is reproduced next time.
ai_complex.intro_about_safety_desc: Built-in safeguards watch every request. If one fails, the rest of your work and document remain unaffected.
ai_complex.intro_about_preview_desc: Review what will change first, and apply only when you want. Irreversible changes are never forced.
ai_complex.intro_about_workload_desc: Pick a workload that matches the size of the task. Light requests go light, complex ones go generous — higher workloads yield richer results, but consume more quota.
ai_complex.intro_about_thinking_desc: A mode where the AI organizes its thoughts once more before answering. Turning on Thinking helps for multi-step or logically complex requests.
ai_complex.info_btn_workload_body: Higher workload means the AI refines the answer across multiple passes from varied angles for a much more careful result. It takes longer and consumes quota faster. If remaining quota can't cover a level, you can't pick it.
ai_complex.info_btn_thinking_body: Before writing the actual answer, the AI takes one more step to organize its thoughts. Useful for complex or tricky requests, but consumes a little more quota.
ai_complex.workload_unaffordable_reason: Only {count} requests left, so this level ({usage}) can't be selected right now

ai_complex.skills_intro: A Skill is a directive describing when and how the AI should combine Tools and writing. Server Skills are uploaded by admins; ones you create here are stored only in this browser.
ai_complex.skill_section_desc: Describe freely what the skill is for. You can also demonstrate directly in the editor (the ⏺ button next to the input).

ai_complex.intro_about_common_base: This base is the common foundation that handles Tool and Skill. Anyone can build and connect it to this editor; the extensions travel anywhere as-is.
ai_complex.intro_about_addendum: On top of that, T2Editor complex AI adds two features of its own.
ai_complex.intro_dev_tools_desc: Things conversation alone can't do — document search, image insertion, external lookups — are performed directly by Tools. The user always decides what to allow; disabled Tools are never used.
ai_complex.intro_dev_skilllite_desc: Instead of heavy knowledge files, it's a short spec describing "when and how to act". Produces consistent results with few tokens.
ai_complex.intro_dev_harness_desc: A common execution layer that holds conversation context, filters inappropriate requests and prompt-injection attempts, and helps Tool calls run reliably to the end. Multiple AI plugins on this base share this harness.
ai_complex.intro_dev_workload_desc: Raising the workload isn't padding the answer; it actually increases the number of API calls. Higher levels mean more round trips to the server, each fetching slightly different angles and depth, then stitched together. So higher levels yield richer results — at the cost of more calls. Which side is better depends on the nature of the task.
ai_complex.intro_dev_thinking_desc: It works independently of whether the connected model has its own reasoning ability. With Thinking on, even models without that ability go through an extra organizing step before answering — producing an effect similar to the model thinking for itself. The internal reasoning is always in English for token efficiency and quality; only the answer shown to you is in your language. Exactly how much it improves is hard to pin down, but complex requests generally benefit.
